privacy: All source head regions were obscured before compositing; no unredacted hardware frame is used.
timing: All eight/twelve source replay frames are held two seconds each, matching source presentation timing, plus a two-second terminal hold. This is not elapsed physical execution time.
scope: Two qualitative controlled-intervention replays; not a controlled model comparison, hardware success rate or sim-to-real estimate. Source false-success annotations have score_validity=trace_only.
progress: Chapter playback position and decision indices only; not world-goal progress.
audio: Original synthesized music, not scene audio.
